description: Everything ONE agent changed on its own branch — the input of the conflict radar, one entry per agent. The record is a VALUE the host builds from its workspace receipts: the agent, the branch (or worktree) name the changes live on, and every path the agent touched. It carries no opinion about conflicts: whether two agents touch the same file is a question the matrix answers from these lists, so a host never has to decide what a conflict is. A path reported twice by the same agent collapses to ONE entry — the LAST one wins, because a receipt that lists a file twice describes the newer fact second, and two cells for one file would make the matrix claim a conflict an agent does not have. The host's path order is preserved otherwise, so a diagnostic reading of the list matches the host's own receipt.

members.name: Find
members.description: The agent's change to one path, or null when the agent did not touch it.

members.name: Agent
members.description: The agent the branch belongs to.

members.name: Branch
members.description: The branch (or worktree) name the host reported. Empty when the host named none.

members.name: ChangedPaths
members.description: The paths the agent touched, de-duplicated by path and in the host's order.

members.name: HasBranch
members.description: Whether the host named the branch.

members.name: HasChanges
members.description: Whether the agent changed anything at all (an agent with no changes is not a matrix column).
